title: Implement Gate 3: Topological & Partial-Order Invariants (Reachability, Fanout, Cycles, Cohesion)
description: Verify mathematical graph and concurrency invariants between observed Canonical IR and curated views.
design:
Four checks:
1. Reachability: Every (from, to, via_relations) pair reachable in observed IR remains reachable in curated view (with shortest-path witness when severed).
2. Biclique Fanout Guard: Enforce in_degree * out_degree <= max_fanout_product (default 25) on bypass_vertices.
3. Cycle & Cohesion Guard: Catch DAGWouldCycle on partition merges (returning cycle witness path) and SemRef cohesion check flagging merges across disconnected/weakly-coupled components.
4. Partial-Order & Concurrency Guard: Ensure bypassing or folding never turns an async/fire-and-forget boundary into a false synchronous blocking call or violates preserve_partial_order constraints.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Severed protected reachability paths fail Gate 3 with witness of the deleted/excluded bottleneck node
- [ ] Merging auth/utils and billing/utils into a cycle-inducing 'Utils' node fails Gate 3 with cycle witness
- [ ] Hub vertex bypass exceeding max_fanout_product fails Gate 3
- [ ] Violated concurrency/happens-before invariants fail Gate 3
close_reason: Merged into main (921ab30) and verified across all 7 quality gates

title: Implement Structural Topological Reduction Operators (Prune, Bypass, Quotient, Slice)
description: Implement leaf pruning, typed vertex bypass, cycle-checked partition contraction, k-hop neighborhood slicing, SCC condensation, and DAG transitive reduction.
design:
On rustworkx.PyDiGraph:
- prune_leaves: remove terminal degree-0 sinks/sources or safe rooted subgraphs (Graphviz prune semantics).
- bypass_vertices: remove_node_retain_edges_by_key splicing matching edge relations & preserving sync/async concurrency mode, recording intermediate node + edges in derived_deterministic.backing_ids.
- collapse_partition: contract_nodes(..., check_cycle=True) raising DAGWouldCycle on newly induced cycles.
- simplify: scc condensation -> DAG transitive_reduction while copying surviving edge attributes & provenance.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] prune_leaves, bypass_vertices, collapse_partition, k_hop_neighborhood, condense_sccs, and transitive_reduction pass unit & property tests
- [ ] Spliced bypass edges and contracted supernodes retain exact backing_ids provenance
- [ ] Transitive reduction preserves edge attributes and runs safely after SCC condensation

title: Define Declarative Curation Spec v1 (diagram-views.yaml) Schema
description: Specify the closed-world YAML/JSON curation DSL emitted by humans or LLM agents and executed deterministically in CI.
design:
Closed-vocabulary operators operating strictly on Canonical IR IDs/globs (zero syntax to invent unbacked edges):
- global_abstractions & per-view ops: prune_leaves, bypass_vertices (preserve_edge_relations, preserve_concurrency_kind, max_fanout_product), collapse_partition (target_node_id, members, exclude_ids), slice (k_hop_neighborhood, upstream/downstream_depth), simplify (condense_sccs, transitive_reduction).
- trace_compaction ops: R1/R2 fold_loops, R3 fold_loop_with_opt, R4 cut_recursion, R5 fold_parallel_siblings (epsilon_ms), R6 fold_parallel_map (max_par_branches), max_call_depth.
- invariants: protected_nodes, preserve_reachability, preserve_partial_order, forbid_new_cycles, node_budget, edge_budget.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] JSON Schema / Pydantic model for diagram-views.yaml v1 validates both structural_graph and interaction_trace specs
- [ ] Schema structurally forbids declaring arbitrary ungrounded edges or nodes
- [ ] Concurrency compaction rules (R5, R6) and partial-order invariants are first-class fields
close_reason: Merged into main (fd5b931) and verified across all 7 quality gates

title: Spike: Parallelism & Concurrency Detection Specification (Runtime Traces + Static Fork-Join)
description: Investigate and specify deterministic algorithms to detect, compact, and lint concurrency/parallelism across runtime distributed traces (OTel) and static async/fork-join call graphs so sequence and dataflow diagrams emit truthful 'par' fragments and async edges.
design:
Four deterministic layers:
1. Single-Trace Clock-Skew-Safe Sweep (Rule R5 - fold_parallel_siblings): Evaluate interval overlap max(start_i, start_j) < min(end_i, end_j) - epsilon strictly among sibling spans sharing the same parent caller clock domain; connected components >= 2 become UML/Mermaid 'par' operands.
2. Homogeneous Parallel Map Compaction (Rule R6 - fold_parallel_map): Collapse N concurrent sibling calls to identical (callee, route/signature) (e.g., Promise.all(items.map(...)), errgroup fan-out) into 'par [N concurrent calls]' instead of N-branch diagram explosion.
3. Series-Parallel Poset Modular Decomposition (Valdes-Tarjan-Lawler O(V+E)): Decompose SpanLinks / multi-trace partial orders into Series (S), Parallel (P -> 'par'), and Prime (induced-N zig-zag a<c, b<c, b<d) modules. Lower Prime modules deterministically via UML weak-sequencing async half-arrows ('-)' / '->>') or PlantUML '!pragma teoz true' anchors without falsifying causality.
4. Static Fork-Join & Async IR Semantics: Normalize Promise.all, asyncio.gather/TaskGroup, Go errgroup.Group/.Go()/.Wait(), and go-callvis goroutine arrowheads into ParallelRegion / async_spawn IR constructs; enforce in Gate 3 that bypass_vertices preserves happens-before partial order and never upgrades async fire-and-forget edges into blocking sync edges.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Formal specification covering R5 sibling overlap, R6 parallel fan-out folding, Series-Parallel DAG decomposition, and induced-N prime fallback
- [ ] Clock-skew safety rules documented for cross-host OTel spans
- [ ] Concurrency edge/event fields aligned with Canonical IR v1 and Curation Spec v1
notes: Initial literature & tool investigation completed during planning: evaluated xtuml/otel2puml, karthyick/tracemaid, NarrativeTrace, Valdes-Tarjan-Lawler (1982) N-free SP-DAG cotrees, and static fork-join AST/SSA idioms (Promise.all, asyncio.gather/TaskGroup, golang.org/x/sync/errgroup).
close_reason: Merged into main (8360b28) and verified across all 7 quality gates

title: Define Two-Profile Canonical IR v1 JSON Schema & Provenance Model
description: Design the language-neutral JSON Schema for ArchiGram's Canonical IR separating factual topology and causal traces from target diagram presentation.
design:
Two profiles:
1. Structural & Class Profile: JGF v2 extended with ELK hierarchical parent_id containment, immutable symbol_id keys, optional OOP class compartments (attributes, method signatures, visibility + - # ~), typed edges (imports, calls, writes_data, inherits, async_spawn, fork_join), and numeric weights.
2. Interaction Trace Profile: Causal DAG (not just tree) of events/spans with participants, parent_event_id, causal_links[], monotonic clock_domain_id + [start_ns, end_ns] intervals, sync_kind (sync, async_fire_forget, fork_join_branch), and status.
Mandatory Provenance Object on every node & edge: grade in {observed, declared, derived_deterministic, inferred} with SHA-256 digests, file/line spans, or rule_id + backing_ids[].
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Canonical IR v1 JSON Schema validates sample structural, OOP class, and concurrent trace fixtures
- [ ] Every node and edge enforces mandatory provenance grade and required audit fields
- [ ] Schema supports both hierarchical containment and causal/parallel trace relationships
close_reason: Merged into main (e800ad9, b7242cb) and verified across all 7 quality gates

title: Implement Deterministic Trace & Parallelism Compaction Engine (R1-R6 + SP-Poset)
description: Compact noisy execution traces and concurrent span DAGs into structured loop, opt, alt, and par sequence fragments.
design:
Implement ordered passes:
- R4: Direct & mutual recursion subtree cut/summary.
- R5 (fold_parallel_siblings): Sweep-line interval overlap within shared parent clock domain -> ParallelBlock ('par').
- R6 (fold_parallel_map): Fold >=K homogeneous concurrent branches inside a ParallelBlock into 'par [N concurrent calls]'.
- Series-Parallel Modular Decomposition (Valdes-Tarjan-Lawler O(V+E)) on SpanLinks / causal DAGs -> Series, Parallel ('par'), and Prime (induced-N lowered to async half-arrows / GeneralOrdering).
- R1/R2/R3: Contiguous repeating subtree hashing -> 'loop [N times]' and 'loop + opt', plus max_call_depth truncation.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] 500-iteration loops and 50-way concurrent fan-outs compact deterministically into bounded loop and par fragments
- [ ] Overlapping sibling spans produce nested par blocks without misclassifying sequential spans
- [ ] Non-series-parallel (induced-N) causal traces lower cleanly to async messages without inventing false ordering barriers

design: Map a mid-sized SCIP graph export to read-only base-model.c4, author curated-views.c4 with include/exclude/where predicates, validate with 'likec4 validate --json --no-layout --file' + @likec4/core element-count check, and export .mmd/.d2 via 'likec4 gen'. Document exact gap boundaries (e.g., vertex bypass path severing, DAGWouldCycle checks, class compartments, R1-R6 trace folding).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Benchmark report documenting what LikeC4 handles natively vs what requires ArchiGram's topological engine
- [ ] Reproducible sample fixture with base-model.c4 and validation timings
close_reason: Merged into main (e800ad9, b7242cb) and verified across all 7 quality gates

title: Implement MCP Server & Bounded 3-Turn Lint-Repair Loop (propose)
description: Expose ArchiGram's digest, curation preview, and 5-Gate Linter via MCP tools and an interactive 'propose' CLI command.
design: MCP tools: get_ir_digest, validate_curation_spec (returns Gate 1-5 JSON diagnostics + repair hints), preview_curated_views (returns node/edge counts + emitted diagram). CLI 'propose' runs temperature-0 structured generation with up to 3 automatic lint-repair turns before saving diagram-views.yaml.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] MCP server exposes digest, lint, and preview tools over stdio
- [ ] Fault-injected LLM rule drafts self-repair within <=3 turns using Gate 1-5 diagnostics
close_reason: Implemented MCP server (get_ir_digest, validate_curation_spec, preview_curated_views) and bounded 3-turn lint-repair loop (propose) with Hypothesis fuzz and pytest-benchmark perf suites

title: Build Compact Graph & Concurrent Trace Digest Generator (Louvain, PageRank, Fanout)
description: Precompute a token-efficient structural and concurrency summary of Canonical IR so LLMs never ingest raw 10,000-line .dot or OTel dumps.
design:
Deterministically compute on Canonical IR:
- Structural: package hierarchy, Louvain communities + inter-module coupling strengths (SemRef), PageRank/betweenness hubs, high-in-degree leaf sinks (loggers/metrics), degree-2 wrapper chains (bypass candidates).
- Trace/Concurrency: top span fan-out sites, candidate R5/R6 parallel regions, deep recursive hotspots.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Digest reduces 500+ node graphs and 2,000-span traces into a compact structured JSON/Markdown summary (<4K tokens)
- [ ] Digest highlights candidate leaf sinks, wrapper chains, cohesive clusters, and parallel fan-out hotspots
close_reason: Merged into main (a26fc01) and verified across all 7 quality gates

title: Epic 7: LLM Control Plane & MCP Server (propose + Lint-Repair Loop)
description: Give coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Orca, Cursor) a low-token structural digest and MCP tool loop to draft and self-repair diagram-views.yaml against the 5-Gate Linter.
design: Strictly decoupled from the CI Data Plane. Supplies compact precomputed graph/trace digests (~0.5% token cost per ASNER/SemRef) and validates proposed YAML rules in a bounded 2-3 turn repair loop.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Coding agents can author and repair valid diagram-views.yaml specs via MCP or 'propose' CLI without raw code context blowup
- [ ] Zero invalid or hallucinated specs escape the 5-Gate repair loop
close_reason: Merged into main (97e8ffb) and verified across all 7 quality gates

title: Build LikeC4 Model & Dynamic Sequence View Emitter (.c4)
description: Emit grounded LikeC4 model and dynamic sequence views (supporting par, loop, opt) from Canonical IR.
design: Serialize Structural IR containment hierarchy to base-model.c4 and curated views / concurrent scenario traces to LikeC4 views/dynamic views.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Emitted .c4 files pass 'likec4 validate --json --no-layout'
- [ ] Dynamic views accurately represent parallel ('par') and loop fragments
close_reason: Merged into main (6a30d19) and verified across all 7 quality gates

title: Build Deterministic PlantUML Emitter (teoz Concurrent Sequences & Class Filter Views)
description: Emit PlantUML sequence diagrams (using !pragma teoz true for parallel fragments/anchors) and curated UML class diagrams (using native post-include hide/remove directives).
design:
For sequence views: emit '!pragma teoz true', 'par ... else ... end', async '->>' arrows, and parallel duration/anchor constructs when needed.
For class views: support both standalone .puml emission and lightweight '!include base.puml' + 'hide private members' / 'remove $tag' / 'remove @unlinked' overlay generation.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Emitted sequence and class .puml files pass 'plantuml -checkonly -failfast2 -stdrpt:1'
- [ ] Concurrent trace branches and non-SP async messages render accurately under teoz
close_reason: Merged into main (5fbbcd6) and verified across all 7 quality gates

title: Build OOP Class Hierarchy Ingestor (pyreverse / JSON)
description: Ingest OOP class, interface, attribute, and method compartment metadata into the Structural/Class Canonical IR.
design: Parse pyreverse exports or typed AST class descriptors (visibility modifiers + - # ~, field types, method signatures, inheritance, composition/aggregation, generic type parameters) into Canonical IR class compartments.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Class attributes, method signatures, visibility modifiers, and generic parameters normalize without symbol collisions
- [ ] Inheritance and composition relationships preserve observed provenance
close_reason: Merged into main (6a30d19) and verified across all 7 quality gates
